input.value: Kitchen fire from stove grease flare-up
Grease fire on stove, extinguished with fire extinguisher. Charred kitchen cabinets above stove, smoke damage on ceiling and walls
Kitchen only; rest of house unaffected

input.rationale: Fire damage to the policyholder's own kitchen cabinets, ceiling, and walls caused by an accidental grease flare-up is clearly property damage to the home structure and contents.

Kitchen fire with charred cabinets above stove and smoke damage to ceiling and walls typically results in damage in the $2,000–$25,000 range (cabinet replacement, drywall repair, painting, smoke remediation). No injuries and damage is confined to one room.

input.claim_summary: Accidental kitchen fire from stove grease flare-up on POL-1001. Charred cabinets above stove and smoke damage to ceiling and walls; fire extinguished by policyholder. No injuries; damage limited to kitchen. Estimated repair costs in medium range ($2k–$25k).
